title: Yale Bright Star Catalogue, 5th edition (BSC5)
locator: catalog.dat fixed-width columns (Vmag 102:107, RA J2000 75:83, Dec J2000 83:90)
note: Primary star catalogue for the issue #122 dynamic night sky. Stars fainter than V = 7.0 are dropped because the naked-eye limiting-magnitude chain (fnc_calculateLimitingMagnitude) clamps at 7.0 and BSC5 is only complete to about 7.0. Positions are J2000.0; precession is applied at run time by fnc_getStarCatalog. The 10-character Name column truncates, so visual doubles that collapse to one string (e.g. 36 Oph A/B) are disambiguated with the HR number by tools/validation/gen_star_catalog.py.

title: IMO 2025 Meteor Shower Calendar
locator: Table 5, Working List of Visual Meteor Showers (activity, peak, solar longitude, radiant, velocity, population index, ZHR)
licence: IMO published calendar; credit the International Meteor Organization
note: Primary source for the issue #122 meteor-shower layer. held_file is the pdftotext -layout extraction of the calendar PDF; the document header reads IMO INFO(3.1-24). tools/validation/gen_meteor_showers.py reads Table 5 only (the eight major annual showers) and transcribes activity window, peak date, solar longitude, radiant RA/Dec, pre-atmospheric velocity, population index r and ZHR. The ZHR definition (reference limiting magnitude +6.5, radiant overhead, meteors per hour) is in the calendar text; the rate-reduction equation implemented by fnc_meteorRate is NOT printed there and is marked UNSOURCED in that function.
